items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Meek is Augustine, yeah. Buell Augustine. She lived right out there on La Perru Street.

ctx.x: Well, her name is Miss Augustine. Buell Augustine? Meek is Augustine, yeah. Buell Augustine. She lived right out there on La Perru Street. But we are, let's see, I think, she's March. She's just, she's a few months, she's a few months younger than I am. But I don't think I could send her there unless I see her, and maybe she could impress her mind. But she had poor memory. And we came up together, and she, I don't remember nothing too much. Ann Buell, sweet. I was telling the gentleman, I don't think I could, I…

Ann Buell, well, tell me this, ma. She's been kind of sick with that stroke and all that. Did you ever listen to jazz bands doing all this? Like a father, when they were, guys would come out of my house when I was a kid, they would go. You know, instead of knocking on the door, they always did that. And a lot of people do that now.
